layouts.name: COcclusionContext_GetArrayBasedCoverageSet
layouts.notes: Follow the CArrayBasedCoverageSet::Add receiver in COcclusionContext::FlushOcclusionRects and the constructor's inline buffer initialization. In 28000.2804, CollectRectangleForOcclusion and CalcVisibleArea pass this + 0x238; the constructor initializes data and initialAllocation to this + 0x258, and IsOccluded reads data at +0x238 and count at +0x250. The old +0x248 points at the two capacity DWORDs (10, 10), explaining issue #358's 0x0000000A0000000A invalid pointer.

layouts.name: COcclusionContext_GetCurrentZ
layouts.notes: COcclusionContext::FlushOcclusionRects increments the depth by two. Distinguish this from the adjacent push-skip counter. Audit neighboring fields independently: build 28000.2704 shifts CurrentZ and the device-transform matrix by four bytes, while the device-transform flags and array-based coverage set remain at their previous offsets. In 28000.2804, FlushOcclusionRects increments +0x4E4; CollectRectangleForOcclusion passes that field as CArrayBasedCoverageSet::Add's depth, and Compute resets it.

layouts.name: COcclusionContext_GetDeviceTransform
layouts.notes: COcclusionContext::UpdateDeviceTransform passes the embedded device-space matrix to CMILMatrix::Multiply. Cross-check SetDeviceTransform's identity/nonidentity writes; CollectRectangleForOcclusion passes the same matrix to CArrayBasedCoverageSet::Add when the independently verified transform flag is set.

layouts.name: COcclusionContext_GetDeviceTransformFlag
layouts.notes: COcclusionContext::FlushOcclusionRects and UpdateDeviceTransform select the device transform or nullptr using this flag. Confirm this packed flag independently from the matrix offset; it remains at 1124 when the matrix moves from 1132 to 1136 in build 28000.2704. In 28000.2804, SetDeviceTransform writes the byte at +0x454; CollectRectangleForOcclusion and IsOccluded test it to select transformed coordinates.

layouts.name: COcclusionContext_GetWorldTransform
layouts.notes: Cross-check the matrix-stack data pointer and count initialized by the COcclusionContext constructor with GetWorldTransform.
